versions.changelog:
新增本地音视频文件转写功能，支持抖音/本地多格式自动识别

- 支持本地视频和音频文件（mp4, mp3, wav, avi, mkv 等）一键转写为中文文本
- 新增脚本：transcribe.py（核心转写/整理逻辑）、transcribe_local.py（本地文件转录入口）
- 抖音链接自动 fallback 双模式：Playwright 与 Douyin API，提升兼容与成功率
- 明确区分两类入口：抖音链接与本地媒体文件，详细列举支持格式
- 移除 skill-card.md，文档聚合于 SKILL.md

Version 1.0.1

- Added automatic environment setup and verification scripts: `setup_env.py` and `verify_env.py`
- Updated documentation with detailed instructions for environment isolation, agent invocation, and troubleshooting
- Enhanced description and trigger logic for more robust detection of user requests involving Douyin video transcription
- Removed obsolete `skill-card.md` file
- Clarified usage of isolated venv and machine-specific configuration via `.env_config.json`
- Improved workflow and file output documentation for reproducibility and agent/LLM integration

- Initial release of douyin-transcribe: extract audio from Douyin short links and transcribe to Chinese text using Whisper.
- Uses Playwright to extract video URLs directly from <video> elements, bypassing login walls.
- Downloads signed Douyin CDN video URLs, handling Referer headers and short-lived URLs.
- Integrates Whisper for accurate Mandarin speech-to-text transcription, with medium model default for quality.
- Automatic FFmpeg setup via imageio for audio extraction.
- Includes fallback script and documentation for full workflow guidance.
